title: Project Gearbound
description: Gearbound is a Minecraft survival modpack focused entirely on mechanical technology and kinetic engineering.
body:
Gearbound is a Minecraft survival modpack focused entirely on mechanical 
technology and kinetic engineering. Instead of relying on digital automation 
or magical networks, progression centers on physical motion, steam power, 
and infrastructure development.

**Core mechanics:**
* Mechanical Automation: Resource processing and factory lines are driven 
  by physical gear systems, belts, and kinetic power.
  
* Logistics and Trains: Players design and operate fully functional steam 
  trains to transport cargo and connect distant outposts.
  
* Exploration and Survival: The world generation and survival loop are 
  tailored to give large-scale industrial infrastructure a practical purpose.
  
* Performance: The pack is optimized for stability, high frame rates, 
  and consistent performance during heavy automation.
